title: Cream of crab soup
lead:
{{Distinguish|Maryland crab soup}}
'''Cream of crab soup''' is a dish from the [[Eastern Shore of Maryland]]. It is made with lump [[Maryland crab|Maryland blue crab]] meat, onion, [[whole milk]] and/or [[Half and half#Dairy product|half and half]] (milk and cream blend), butter, either flour or corn starch as a thickener, and [[Old Bay Seasoning|Old Bay]] as the main seasoning. Additional flavorings may include dry [[sherry]], dried dill, [[celery salt]], lemon, and black pepper. Some variations include chicken broth as well.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Cream of Crab Soup Recipe |url=https://www.visitmaryland.org/article/cream-crab-soup-recipe |access-date=2026-01-25 |website=Maryland Office of Tourism |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Maryland’s Eastern Shore Cream of Crab Soup {{!}} Kidney-Friendly Recipes |url=https://davita.com/diet-nutrition/recipes/soups-stews/marylands-eastern-shore-cream-of-crab-soup/ |access-date=2026-01-25 |website=DaVita |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Maryland's Eastern Shore Cream of Crab Soup |url=https://diabetesfoodhub.org/recipes/marylands-eastern-shore-cream-crab-soup |access-date=2026-01-25 |website=American Diabetes Association}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Cream of Crab Soup Recipe |url=https://www.mccormick.com/blogs/old-bay-recipes/cream-of-crab-soup |access-date=2026-01-25 |website=McCormick |language=en}}</ref>
